dashboard.user_subtitle: Here is your personalized E-Raport prediction based on your recent activities.
dashboard.teacher_subtitle: Here is your overview of assigned user accounts and their predictive analytics.
dashboard.x1_desc: Attendance consistency directly shapes your next exam prediction.
dashboard.x2_desc: This is your average academic record signal across complete tryout history.
dashboard.x3_desc: Teacher objective score adds guided assessment context to the prediction.
dashboard.y_desc: Generated from the final HiveEdu MLR formula using X1, X2, and X3.
dashboard.risk_desc: This flag highlights whether your current prediction is inside a safe band.
dashboard.personal_desc: Your next exam score is projected from attendance consistency, average tryout history, and teacher objective score, then clamped into the 0-100 HiveEdu score range.
dashboard.prediction_explanation_desc: This score is explained through the three research variables that HiveEdu is tracking for your progress.
dashboard.formula_x2: X2 represents your average tryout score history.
dashboard.formula_x3: X3 represents your teacher objective score from Academic Records.
dashboard.formula_y: Y is your predicted next exam score generated from those three inputs.
dashboard.recommendation_desc: A direct next step generated from your current attendance, tryout, and teacher objective pattern.
dashboard.recommended_action: Keep improving all three signals together to move your predicted next exam score deeper into the safe range.
dashboard.prediction_breakdown_desc: See how each factor contributes to your final predicted score. Each bar represents the individual contribution from the MLR model.
dashboard.x2_trend_desc: This line tracks your academic record average over time using saved tryout history.
dashboard.competency_radar_desc: A visual snapshot of your latest competency balance across Mathematics, Logical Reasoning, and English Proficiency.
dashboard.what_if_desc: Adjust the sliders to see how improving your attendance, tryout scores, or teacher objective impacts your predicted final exam score in real-time.
dashboard.no_competency_data: No competency score data is available yet.
dashboard.no_tryout_desc: Your X2 trend will appear here after academic records are saved for your account.
dashboard.badges_perfect_attendance_desc: You maintained flawless attendance across all recorded sessions.
dashboard.badges_consistent_attendance_desc: Your attendance is operating inside a highly reliable range.
dashboard.badges_tryout_achiever_desc: Your average tryout performance is operating at an advanced level.
dashboard.badges_safe_zone_desc: Your predicted next exam score is currently inside the safe performance band.
dashboard.gamification_desc: Milestones unlock automatically as your attendance consistency, tryout quality, and predictive safety improve.
dashboard.keep_pushing: Keep pushing your attendance and academic performance to unlock premium milestones.
dashboard.global_comparison_desc: Compare your current metrics against the live class average generated from active users in the HiveEdu model.
dashboard.global_comparison_not_available: Global comparison is not available yet.
dashboard.global_comparison_will_appear: This comparison will appear once both your analytics and the class average are ready.
dashboard.what_if_pro_tip: Pro-tip: Focus on increasing your X2 (Tryout) score as it usually has a strong coefficient multiplier in the MLR formula.
dashboard.no_priority_intervention: No priority intervention needed right now.
dashboard.draft_modal_generating: Generating personalized message via Groq LLaMA-3...
dashboard.badge_early_improvement_desc: Your current analytics signal is highlighting an area to improve before the next exam.

tour.step1: Welcome to HiveEdu Analytics! Let's start a quick tour to familiarize you with the available Enterprise features.
tour.step2: This is the sidebar navigation. You can access all modules here.
tour.step3: You can toggle between light and dark themes here.
tour.step4: Here is an overview of the key analytics metrics for your institution.
tour.step5: These are the AI Predictions, calculated based on the latest academic data.
tour.step6: Use the What-If Simulator to forecast potential score outcomes by adjusting variables.
tour.step7: Meet your personalized Llama-3 Academic Counselor, providing dynamic insights.
tour.step8: When you are done, you can export your analytics report to a PDF here.

analytics.title: Analytics Engine
analytics.desc: Monitor the HiveEdu regression engine, review live coefficients, and export a complete analytics workbook from one control surface.
analytics.formula_desc: X1 represents attendance percentage, X2 represents average tryout score, X3 represents teacher objective score from Academic Records, and Y represents the predicted next exam score.
analytics.intercept_desc: — baseline constant added to every prediction.
analytics.b2_x2_desc: — tryout contribution = tryout coefficient × average tryout score.
analytics.b3_x3_desc: — teacher objective contribution = teacher objective coefficient × teacher objective score.
analytics.final_score_clamped: Final score is clamped between 0 and 100.
analytics.x3_sourced: X3 is sourced from Teacher Objective Score in Academic Records.
analytics.mse_desc: Latest validation result from the most recent analytics run.
analytics.generate_workbook: Generate the final HiveEdu analytics workbook with prediction results, early warning coverage, coefficient details, dataset quality, attendance aggregates, tryout aggregates, and MLR run history.
analytics.intercept_desc_inline: — baseline constant added to every prediction.
analytics.b2_desc_inline: — tryout contribution = tryout coefficient × average tryout score.
analytics.b3_desc_inline: — teacher objective contribution = teacher objective coefficient × teacher objective score.
